claim_attributions.claim_text: Deterministic readiness: fatigued (score 49.0). The athlete is currently in a fatigued state, indicated by the readiness score of 49 out of 100 and the overreach risk score of 58. The recent 7-day load (4.12 hours) is within the 28-day baseline (20.6 hours), but the recovery signals (sleep, HRV, resting heart rate) are not fully supporting aggressive progression. The athlete’s profile indicates a developing recreational level, which means they are still building their fitness and need to be cautious with volume and intensity.
Continue prioritizing easy sessions and rest days to support recovery.
Monitor sleep duration and quality closely, aiming for at least 7 hours per night.
Maintain a consistent bedtime routine to support better sleep.
Consider incorporating light stretching or foam rolling to aid recovery between sessions.
Focus on hydration and nutrition to support recovery efforts.
Avoid alcohol and heavy meals close to bedtime to improve sleep quality.
